numerator: Published mean of individual-seed original-unit RMSE; R=6 for neural networks and R=1 for deterministic references.
formula: float(numerator_RMSE)/float(reference_RMSE); no predictions, new scoring or resampling
interpretation: Dimensionless ratio below1 means lower observed RMSE than the reference; equals1 is same numerical score; above1 means higher observed RMSE. It is a ratio of published aggregated RMSE, not MASE, a paired effect CI, statistical equivalence, or proof of gain exceeding delta.
